wo-jpfa-JR3804.d:
Job Summary**

Responsible for the efficient operation, routine maintenance, and troubleshooting of production equipment within the In-Line 4 processing unit, ensuring continuous and safe production in accordance with company standards.

Job Responsibilities**

* Operate and monitor production machinery and equipment according to established procedures and safety guidelines.
* Perform routine preventive maintenance tasks, including lubrication, cleaning, inspections, and minor adjustments to optimize equipment performance and extend lifespan.
* Identify and troubleshoot basic mechanical, electrical, and operational issues, performing immediate corrective actions or escalating complex problems to senior technicians or supervisors.
* Conduct quality checks on products during the production process, ensuring adherence to specifications and reporting any deviations.
* Record production data, maintenance activities, and equipment status accurately and timely.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment, adhering to all health, safety, and environmental regulations.
* Collaborate with production and maintenance teams to optimize workflows and resolve operational challenges.
* Participate in training programs to enhance technical skills and knowledge of new equipment or processes.

Job Qualifications**

* Diploma or equivalent; a technical certificate or vocational training in mechanical, electrical, or industrial maintenance is a plus.
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in an industrial production or maintenance role, preferably within a food processing or manufacturing environment.
* Basic understanding of mechanical systems, hydraulics, pneumatics, and electrical components.
* Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, schematics, and operating procedures.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Good physical condition, capable of lifting heavy objects and standing for extended periods.
* Willingness to work in shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as required.
* Adherence to safety protocols and food safety standards.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
